Feedback Message: Order was never dispatched and the buyer was only told the item was out of stock on the day delivery was due.
AI Root Cause: Item remained sellable while out of stock, and the unfulfillable order was not flagged to the buyer until the promised delivery date had arrived.
Suggested Action: Review inventory sync & stock accuracy; add a proactive buyer notification the moment an order is identified as unfulfillable rather than at the delivery date.

Feedback Message: Item arrived much smaller than the listing text led the buyer to expect, and they were told to pay return postage to get a refund.
AI Root Cause: Listing text omits the size or scale of the product, creating an expectation mismatch on arrival; the return was then treated as a change-of-mind return with buyer-paid postage rather than a not-as-described case.
Suggested Action: Audit listing description accuracy - add explicit dimensions and an in-scale image; review how not-as-described returns are triaged, since charging return postage on these escalated the complaint.

Feedback Message: Item advertised for 2-3 day delivery was never handed to the carrier, and the buyer received three conflicting explanations while chasing it.
AI Category: Fulfillment Issue - Non-Dispatch with Inconsistent Communication
AI Root Cause: Item was sold against stock that was not physically available so it was never dispatched, and support issued successive contradictory explanations instead of confirming the true dispatch status.
Suggested Action: Review inventory sync & stock accuracy; give support a single authoritative dispatch/handover status to quote so buyers are not given conflicting reasons.

Feedback Message: Buyer likes the product but cannot open the fitting to wire it up, and requested a refund after slow seller responses.
AI Root Cause: The fitting cannot be opened to reach the wiring terminal - either an enclosure design or assembly fault, or missing wiring instructions - and slow support responses turned a fixable issue into a refund request.
Suggested Action: Escalate to product team for design review of enclosure access on this combo; confirm wiring instructions ship with the unit and check support response times on this account.
